{"consolidated_memory":"**Flapping Flag Issues in platform/featureflags/eval.go** (Multiple Occasions)

All three incidents involved the same symptom (alternating decision returns) and repro method (evaluate the same flag for one user repeatedly) in the same file region (platform/featureflags/eval.go, platform side), but had different root causes and manifested under different conditions. Context carried over between incidents due to same corner of codebase.

---

**Occasion 1: [2026-03-09] Connection Pool Exhaustion**
- Trigger: jobs scheduled across midnight boundary
- Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: raised pool ceiling and put bounded wait queue in front of it
- PR: #2679 on branch fix/flapping-flag-2
- Outcome: reclaimed 68 GB of blob storage

**Occasion 2: [2026-06-12] Floating Point Rounding**
- Trigger: only appeared on staging read replica
- Root cause: floating point rounding in the money path
- Fix: moved arithmetic to integer minor units
- PR: #3397 on branch fix/flapping-flag-3
- Outcome: nightly rollup matched source counts for 62 days running

**Occasion 3: [2026-08-02] Timezone Awareness**
- Trigger: clients pinned to v1 SDK
- Root cause: naive datetime compared against aware datetime
- Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR: #7336 on branch fix/flapping-flag-4
- Outcome: memory settled at 612 MB instead of climbing past 9 GB"}
